mandatoryCriteria: Remove empty column: DELETE /api/v1/boards/:boardId/columns/:columnId succeeds when column contains no cards
Reject final column deletion: Rejects deletion if board has only 1 column remaining with 400 FINAL_COLUMN_CANNOT_BE_DELETED
Reject column with active cards: Rejects deletion with 400 or 409 if column contains active cards; no silent cascade
Reject column with restorable cards: Rejects deletion or flags blocked restore if column contains trashed cards within 24h restore window
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Safe empty column deletion with reference guards.
